programme.title: Mela
programme.desc: Best mates Kishen and Shankar decide to help village belle Roopa avenge her family's death, but their friendship is tested in the process.

programme.title: Satya
programme.desc: Durga's brother is killed in a gang war, turning him into a revenge-seeking man with a mission. Now, his ex-girlfriends cop husband is out to get him. Finally, the two team up to nab the real culprit.

programme.title: Demon
programme.desc: Vignesh Shivan has scary dreams that bother him a lot. However, the strange things in his dreams make him worry and affect his mind.

programme.title: Hum Hai Champions
programme.desc: Mallika is blackmailed by a dangerous don to fall in love with his rival's son Panda and eventually murder him. However, Panda is already madly in love with her and does not see what is coming.

programme.title: Maati Maangey Khoon
programme.desc: Hariya is clueless about his parents and discovers that his family was destroyed by Thakur Balram Singh. He vows to take revenge, especially after his friend, who is Balram's nephew, also opposes him.

programme.title: Agnivarsha
programme.desc: In a kingdom stricken with drought, two rival priests, Yavakri and Parvasu, try to appease the rain god, Indra. However, their efforts result in adultery, treachery.

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Katilon Ke Kaatil
programme.desc: A wealthy widow meets Munna and Ajit and assumes them to be her estranged sons. She takes them into her house, unaware that their intentions are to loot her entire wealth.

programme.title: Laila
programme.desc: As a young boy, Deshraj was sent away for higher studies in order to protect him from a rival family's wrath. But upon his return, he falls in love with a girl who is the daughter of the same enemy.

programme.title: Koyelaanchal
programme.desc: An honest IAS officer rises against the atrocities of a brutal mafioso. In retaliation, the mafioso sends a deadly human weapon to kill the officer, who instead ends up abducting his child.

programme.title: Drishyam
programme.desc: When the disappearance of a policewoman's son threatens to ruin Vijay's family, he leaves no stone unturned in order to shield his family.

programme.title: The Real Hunter
programme.desc: To fuel his political ambitions, Vijay's father fixes his marriage with an affluent girl. However, after Vijay falls for an ordinary villager and plans on marrying her, his father plans to stop him.

programme.title: Alag
programme.desc: Tejas, an odd boy who grew up in a basement, is moved to a rehabilitation centre after his father's death. When he starts displaying psychic powers, a scientist abducts him for experimentation.

programme.title: Hatya: The Murder
programme.desc: Ravi's father, Ratan, gets killed when he refuses to sell his land to Murugan, a wealthy businessman. Later, Ravi sets out to avenge the death of his father.

programme.title: Farz
programme.desc: Gopal, a secret agent, investigates the death of his colleague who possessed evidence against a known terrorist. Gopal and Kamla embark on a journey to find the traitor.

programme.title: Majaal
programme.desc: Vijay falls in love with Sadhana and marries her, but on several occasions, he is disrespected by his in-laws. Frustrated, he loses interest in his married life.

programme.title: Sahadev
programme.desc: An infamous and merciless contract killer percolates through the illegal arms business by taking up the occupation of a cotton farmer.

programme.title: Ek Aur Bhool Bhulaiyaa
programme.desc: Nakulan and his family move into his supposedly haunted ancestral property. However, when his cousin starts behaving uncharacteristically, Nakulan enlists the help of his psychiatrist friend.

programme.title: Race
programme.desc: Two stepbrothers own a huge stud farm and a horse racing business. When they learn that they have a common love interest, one of them tries to kill the other and inherit the insurance money.

programme.title: Ek Aur Hero The Dashing
programme.desc: After the death of their eldest brother, Babloo and the other three brothers develop hatred towards women. However, things take a turn when Babloo falls in love with Pooja.

programme.title: Krishna Arjun
programme.desc: Sharda Yadav, a widow, lives with her two sons, Krishna and Arjun. Arjun is studying in Mumbai when he hears that his mother has passed away and Krishna has been arrested for raping a widow.

programme.title: Mast
programme.desc: Kittu is madly in love with Malika, an actress, and travels to her house in Mumbai from Pune after his father scolds him for his decreasing exam scores.

programme.title: Hiraasat
programme.desc: ACP Ashok Saxena is an honest middle-class police officer who lives with his wife, Shobha, and college-going brother, Rajesh. However, he is framed in a case of drug-trafficking and gets arrested.

programme.title: Kaun Kare Kurbanie
programme.desc: Honest and upright, Inspector Arjun is very different from his happy-go-lucky younger brother Ajit. Their relationship hits rocky ground after Ajit is accused of murder.

programme.title: Dhadkan
programme.desc: Anjali and Dev are in love with each other and plan to marry, but her family gets her married to Ram. Years later, Dev shows up to reunite with Anjali, however, she has fallen in love with Ram.

programme.title: Guddu Ki Gun
programme.desc: Guddu, a salesman, lands in dire trouble when his girlfriend's grandfather casts a spell on him for cheating on her. However, he must find true love to get rid of the curse.

programme.title: Ek Lahoo
programme.desc: Ashok and Lakshmi share an ideal brother-sister relationship. They find their perfect matches and lead a happily married life until Ashok's wife's aunt comes into their life and creates mayhem.

programme.title: Dharmyudh
programme.desc: A successful man tries to reconnect with his old teacher only to find out that she is in deep trouble. Upon learning this, he decides to do everything he can to save her.

programme.title: Aakhri Ghulam
programme.desc: Bheema, his father Dinu and generations of their family have been slaves of the wealthy Thakurs. One day, he challenges their authority and invites trouble for himself in the process.

programme.title: 16 December
programme.desc: Four Indian Revenue Service officers are assigned to intercept and arrest a group of Pakistani terrorists. The terrorists plot to detonate a nuclear bomb in New Delhi and the IRS must stop them.

programme.title: Juaari
programme.desc: Vijay, a young man, resorts to gambling in order to free his lover, Anita, who is held captive by Sanga. He soon runs out of luck when he gets arrested.

programme.title: Insaniyat
programme.desc: In order to combat terrorism, Inspector Amar has to convince two local crime lords, divided by religion, to work together. He also learns that being an honest cop has its own price.

programme.title: Josh
programme.desc: Max, who lives with his twin sister Shirley in Goa, is enraged when he finds out that she has fallen in love with Rahul, his bitter rival Prakash's younger brother.

programme.title: Kaali Topi Laal Roomaal
programme.desc: Commando Vijay arrests a terrorist, Master DD. However, he realises that Master DD is just a pawn and tries to find the real culprit.

programme.title: 100 Days of Love
programme.desc: Despite their strained history as children, a columnist falls in love with his schoolmate when they meet after years. Just as he decides to win her heart, he learns that she is engaged to another man.

programme.title: Prithipal Singh...A Story
programme.desc: Disappointed with his Olympic bronze medal, Prithipal Singh quits hockey and joins a university. However, things get worse for him when he is accused of murdering a student.

programme.title: Karishma Kudrat Ka
programme.desc: Widower Vijay lives in a village with his family. He unwittingly makes an enemy in Lala and a bandit, Bhagad, who conspire and throw him out of the village. But Vijay soon returns as a changed man.

programme.title: Avinash
programme.desc: Avinash, a singer and a dealer of stolen goods, finds his life turned upside down when some goons break into his house and assault his fiancee.

programme.title: Alag
programme.desc: Tejas, an odd boy who grew up in a basement, is moved to a rehabilitation centre after his father's death. When he starts displaying psychic powers, a scientist abducts him for experimentation.

programme.title: Jungle
programme.desc: Anu and Siddhu are in love and Siddhu turns up when Anu's family camps in a tiger sanctuary for a holiday. Unexpectedly, a sandalwood smuggler takes several members as hostages.

programme.title: Yes Boss
programme.desc: Rahul's boss Siddharth is a womaniser who blackmails Rahul into helping him win over Seema. But Rahul ends up falling in love with Seema and is torn between his career aspirations and his sweetheart.

programme.title: Payback
programme.desc: The lives of an architect and his wife are turned upside down when a stranger kidnaps their daughter and blackmails them to do some crimes for him.

programme.title: Powerfull Yoddha
programme.desc: Chandu is very passionate about kickboxing and his life revolves around his mother and his girlfriend. His life is shattered when his dying mother asks him to meet his estranged father Raghuveer.

programme.title: Dhongee
programme.desc: Chandran lies to his boss that his mother is unwell to get a leave but gets caught. In order to save his job, he is forced to pretend to his boss that he has a good-for-nothing twin brother.

programme.title: Aaj Ka Mahaatma
programme.desc: Randhir, a straightforward and hardworking man, sets out to avenge the death of his twin brother Ranvir, a criminal, who was murdered by a prison inmate.

programme.title: Falak
programme.desc: Ramnath, a watchman, is killed while stopping his corrupt bosses from committing a crime. Years later, his sons decide to exact revenge against his murderers.

programme.title: Farz
programme.desc: Gopal, a secret agent, investigates the death of his colleague who possessed evidence against a known terrorist. Gopal and Kamla embark on a journey to find the traitor.

programme.title: Shehzaade
programme.desc: Suraj, a justice-loving man, must face a series of obstacles when he discovers his widowed mother's affair with a former prisoner.

programme.title: 15th August
programme.desc: Nagpal kills Chaudhry and his son, Ram, a military officer. Chaudhry's second son, Vikram, vows to destroy Nagpal who is all set to become the Chief Minister on the upcoming Indian Independence Day.

programme.title: Ghatak
programme.desc: When Kashi visits a community with his father, he is shocked to see the torturous regime of Katya. He tries to oppose Katya, but ends up compromising the safety of his family and relatives.

programme.title: Zindagi Gulzar Hai
programme.desc: Kashaf, a young woman raised by a single mother, faces a lot of class and gender bias while growing up. However, her life turns around when she meets Zaroon in college.

programme.title: Azad Desh Ka Andha Kanoon
programme.desc: A brash and honest policeman is torn apart between his duties and saving his family when his own brother is caught in a blue-film scam. He also must protect a sole witness whose life is in danger.

programme.title: Rustum
programme.desc: ACP Abhishek Bhargav is determined to find the culprits behind the death of his friend, DCP Bharath. His investigation takes him to Bangalore, where he uncovers revelations of an organ trade mafia.

programme.title: Pyar Ke Kabil
programme.desc: Kiran and Jyoti are twins who were separated after their parents uncoupled. Years later, they meet accidentally at a picnic and decide to exchange places in an effort to reunite their parents.

programme.title: Barah Aana
programme.desc: Three men accidentally stumble into the world of crime when they start kidnapping for small ransoms in order to improve their lifestyles. However, they soon realise that it is not a bad business.

programme.title: Krishna Arjun
programme.desc: Sharda Yadav, a widow, lives with her two sons, Krishna and Arjun. Arjun is studying in Mumbai when he hears that his mother has passed away and Krishna has been arrested for raping a widow.

programme.title: Mafia Raaj
programme.desc: An honest police officer has a mission to wipe out a mafia group. But in the process, he is forced to sacrifice not only his father but also his sister.

programme.title: Mela
programme.desc: Best mates Kishen and Shankar decide to help village belle Roopa avenge her family's death, but their friendship is tested in the process.

programme.desc: Pat The Hapless goes on a barbaric quest to the shopping mall in 'Chopping Spree', then in 'All Bot Myself', after Captain Quasar buys a new robot, Pat-Tron works for the Star family. (S3, ep 2)

programme.desc: The campers meet two backwoods narwhals in 'Sugar Squeeze', then in 'Tag, You're It', On a rainy day, SpongeBob and his friends entertain themselves indoors with a turbulent game of tag. (S1, ep 2)

programme.desc: Krabs reignites his passion for clowning in 'Krabsy the Klown', then in 'Lords of the LARP', Mo learns a new kind of fun and camaraderie. (S2, ep 8)

programme.title: Kamp Koral

programme.desc: SpongeBob befriends a talking Krabby Patty whose only wish is to be eaten in 'My Friend Patty', then in 'Fun-Believable', Rube explores little known oddities and attractions around Bikini Bottom.

programme.desc: Patrick and GrandPat try to pass each other on the stairs in 'Stair Wars', then in 'Enemies a la Mode', the members of the Star family each confront their own absurd rivalries. (S1, ep 2)

programme.desc: The Star family gets trapped in the bathroom in 'The Commode Episode', then in 'Tying the Klop-Knot', Bunny and Cecil need to have another Klopnodian wedding. (S2, ep 6)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: In 'Bubblestand' SpongeBob introduces his friends to the art of bubble blowing, and in 'Ripped Pants' SpongeBob tries to impress Sandy at Mussel Beach. (S1, ep 2)

programme.desc: Patrick and SpongeBob time-travel back to Viking times in 'Visiting Vikings', then in 'It's Too Late... With Plankton' Squidina hires Plankton to entertain the Lawnies. (S4, ep 12)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Bunny's mother visits from the old country in 'Which Witch is Which?', and then in 'Get Off My Lawnie', Granny Tentacles gets her own spin-off show. (S1, ep 25)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob shrinks the whole of Bikini Bottom in 'Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy IV', and then in 'Doing Time', Mrs. Puff is sent to prison when SpongeBob crashes his boat.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: Camp Master Krabs hires the Flying Dutchman to run the camp store in 'Boo Light Special', then in 'Lake Crashers', The campers have a demolition derby under Lake Yuckymuck. (S1, ep 18)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: An unsatisfied anchovy strays from his brothers in 'What About Meep?', then in 'Hard Time Out', SpongeBob is sent to time out on behalf of his buddy, so Patrick does what he can to help. (S1, ep 7)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob's favourite jellyfishing net goes missing in 'The Pink Purloiner', and then in 'Squid Wood', SpongeBob decides that if he can't hang around with the real Squidward, he'll make his own.

programme.title: The Boston Strangler
programme.desc: 1968. Drama. Director: Richard Fleischer. Stars Tony Curtis, Henry Fonda & Sally Kellerman. When a string of women in Boston start turning up dead, the police launch an investigation.

programme.title: Francis Durbridge's The Passenger
programme.desc: The Passenger Part One. 1971. Stars Peter Barkworth, Joanna Dunham & Arthur Pentelow. Businessman David Walker picks up a hitcher, and his personal and professional problems get a whole lot worse.

programme.title: Francis Durbridge's The Passenger
programme.desc: The Passenger Part Two. 1971. Stars Peter Barkworth, Joanna Dunham & Arthur Pentelow. The main suspect in Judy Clayton's murder kills himself. The case should be finished, but more deaths follow.

programme.title: Francis Durbridge's The Passenger
programme.desc: The Passenger Part Three. 1971. Stars Peter Barkworth, Joanna Dunham & Arthur Pentelow. Inspector Denson begins a chain of events in an attempt to flush out the killer.

programme.title: Shadows on the Stairs
programme.desc: 1941. Crime. Director: D. Ross Lederman. Stars Frieda Inescort & Paul Cavanagh. Occupants of a boarding house become suspects after a string of murders.

programme.title: Night Call with the Brighton Police
programme.desc: 1953. A dramatic and unique police training film from the Brighton police force.

programme.title: Stagecoach West
programme.desc: The Orphans. Wayne Rogers & Robert Bray run a stagecoach line in the Old West, where they come across a wide variety of killers, robbers and ladies in distress.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Penguin Goes Straight. 1966. Stars Adam West & Burgess Meredith. The Penguin announces he will protect the wealthy with his Penguin Protective Agency, but Batman and Robin are suspicious.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Not Yet, He Ain't. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burgess Meredith & Kathleen Crowley. When the Penguin discovers Batman and Robin have escaped, he organises a manhunt to apprehend the dirty duo.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: The Case of the Perfect Husband. 1955. Starring Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford & Archie Duncan. The wife of a killer is in danger. Holmes and Watson must race against the clock to stop him.

programme.title: The Great Game (1952)
programme.desc: 1952. Comedy. Director: Maurice Elvey. Stars Diana Dors, Thora Hird & John Laurie. A wealthy chairman of Burnville United makes an unethical approach to a star player of another club.

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse: The Answer
programme.desc: 1954. Drama. Directed by Roy Kellino. Stars David Niven, Anthony Caruso & Nestor Paiva. A dissatisfied Hollywood writer returns to his old bar, where he meets an intellectual alcoholic.

programme.title: Dance, Fools, Dance
programme.desc: 1931. Drama. Director: Harry Beaumont. Stars Joan Crawford & Cliff Edwards. After the death of their father and loss of the family fortune, a brother and sister are forced to make major changes.

programme.title: The Bells Go Down
programme.desc: 1943. Drama. Director: Basil Dearden. Stars Tommy Trinder, James Mason & Philip Friend. A bettor, a bridegroom, and a thief volunteer for the London Auxiliary Fire Service during World War Two.

programme.title: The Heart Within
programme.desc: 1957. Drama. Directed by David Eady. Stars James Hayter, Earl Cameron & David Hemmings. A murder suspect on the run must depend on strangers to help prove his innocence and clear his name.

programme.title: The Duchess of Duke Street
programme.desc: Lottie's Boy. 1976. Stars Gemma Jones, Anthony Andrews & Victoria Plucknett. A young guest creates a rift between Mary and Louisa and persuades the Major to invest money in a risky venture.

programme.title: An Inspector Calls
programme.desc: 1954. Crime. Director: Guy Hamilton. Stars Alastair Sim, Olga Lindo, Eileen Moore. The Birling family are rich and complacent. It is 1912, and the impending war has yet to fall across their lives.

programme.title: Look At Life Sea Horses
programme.desc: 1962. A look at the essential part of a port - tugboats, without which any big port would come to a standstill.

programme.title: Julius Hagen Season
programme.desc: This week, Noel invites us to take our seats at a grand opera as we return to the wonderful world of film producer Julius Hagen with the 1934 feature Broken Melody.

programme.title: The Broken Melody
programme.desc: 1934. Directed by Bernard Vorhaus. Paul Verlaine, a struggling composer (John Garrick) is supported by Germaine (Merle Oberon) who is secretly in love with him.

programme.title: Julius Hagen Season
programme.desc: Tune in to find out which brilliant Julius Hagen film will be shown next week.

programme.title: Strange But True?
programme.desc: Andrew Green the Ghostbuster/Psychic Pets. 1997. Michael Aspel talks to Andrew Green, a paranormal investigator about his work and asks the question, do animals have a sixth sense?

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: Public Concern. 1974. Stars Jean Anderson, John Baddeley & Colin Baker. A local petition, protesting about Hammond's lorries, threatens the company's plans to go public.

programme.title: Mark Saber
programme.desc: Hidden Money. 1957. Stars Donald Gray, Diana Chesney & Noel Dyson. Mrs. Benton has been murdered - her son is sole beneficiary, and he is also the number one suspect.

programme.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters Social Club
programme.desc: Episode 22. 1975. Bernard Manning and Colin Crompton present In Three Minds, Jerry Stevens, Vintage Syncopators, Itojo Kumano, Mike Carter and Barbara Sharon.

programme.title: Modesty Blaise
programme.desc: 1966. Action. Director: Joseph Losey. Stars Monica Vitti, Dirk Bogarde & Terrence Stamp. A spy spoof in the 60s tradition with comic book heroine, Modesty Blaise. Set in the Italian Mediterranean.

programme.title: Maybe I'll Come Home in the Spring
